title: Women's Bear – Mama Bear, Hibernation Denied Hoodie

seo.title: Mama Bear Hoodie: Hibernation Denied Pullover
seo.description: A funny mama bear hoodie for tired moms: a bear, a camp mug and two climbing cubs. 8 oz pullover, S-3XL, printed to order. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

A wide-awake mama bear sits at the mouth of her snowy den with a steaming camp mug while two cubs climb over her head, and the hoodie says MAMA BEAR, HIBERNATION DENIED. This mama bear hoodie is for the mom whose kids never sleep, on early school runs and winter weekends alike.

The print is a 1970s park-poster scene: a big black bear with tired half-closed eyes holds an enamel camp mug in one paw, two cubs scramble over her head and shoulders, and snow falls on the pines and den rocks around her. MAMA BEAR is in rust script above and HIBERNATION DENIED. in slab capitals below.

Wear it to the 6 a.m. school run, a snowy cabin weekend or the sideline, and give it to the mom whose cubs have never heard of a long winter nap. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What is the Mama Bear, Hibernation Denied hoodie?
It is a pullover graphic hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. showing a tired mama bear with a camp mug and two climbing cubs, lettered MAMA BEAR, HIBERNATION DENIED. It is a Gildan 18500 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece with a double-lined hood, drawcord and front pouch pocket.

How does the pullover hoodie fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with ribbed cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a roomier layer over a tee or sweater. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The hoodie is 50% pre-shrunk cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a cold school run or a cabin porch. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the rust and cream inks from fading and the fleece soft after many washes.

Is it a good gift for a mom?
Yes. It suits the mom who laughs about never sleeping, and it is an easy Christmas gift from kids or a partner. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $39.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a birthday or Mother's Day.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. mama bear hoodie should arrive before Christmas. Each hoodie is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
